name: vortex
title: Vortex
description: Turn round the centre and slip through the gaps as walls close in on the beat. Six stages written to their own songs, each in a world of its own, and a hyper of each; race the ghost of your best, medals that open new looks, Endless, a daily run, practice from any rank, and a retry one key away.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the music and the sounds are; M in the game turns them off.

store.tagline: Slip through the closing walls, on the beat

actions.title: Turn
actions.description: Round the centre, either way; A and D too. Hold Shift to turn slowly for a fine line.

actions.title: Play, or play again
actions.description: After a death the next run is one key away.

actions.title: Choose a stage
actions.description: Left and right on the stages; up for a stage's hyper once you've cleared it.

actions.title: Practice
actions.description: On a stage: start from a rank you've reached there.

actions.title: Your look
actions.description: The player's shape and trail, opened by medals; the ghost on or off.

features: Walls close in on the centre with one way through; turn to the gap before they reach you, while the world spins, reverses and changes shape
Six stages written to their songs: walls land on the beat, builds tighten and go dark, every drop hits with a slam on its downbeat
Each stage its own world: neon, a nebula, glass, deep water, acid speed, a black hole; and a hyper of each, faster and in other colours
Race the ghost of your best run, see what killed you again in slow motion, hear every near miss
Medals for clearing, for a steady hand and for near misses, which open new shapes and trails for the player
Endless (every stage in turn, then their hypers), a daily run with the same walls for everyone, and practice from any rank you've reached

screenshots.caption: Pulse: a neon grid far below, walls that read at a glance, and you, racing a minute against the song
Undertow: caustics and bubbles under a half-time song, the moment a record falls
Singularity in hyper: a black hole at the centre, the last stage, faster
A death replays slowly with the wall that got you outlined; the card says how close the record and the next rank were
The stages, each playing itself behind its card: your best, its rank, your medals, practice from a rank you reached
Medals open new shapes and trails for the player; the ghost of your best run, on or off

vortex.title: Vortex
vortex.description: Turn round the centre through the closing walls. Escape or closing the panel pauses a run.

keys.title: Turn (arrows or A and D; Shift turns slowly)
Practice from a rank, on the stages
